text: Baccha paida hua, aur aapne har mahine ₹10,000 ka SIP shuru kiya. 18 saal baad, use kya milega?
Aapki jeb se jaayenge, ₹21 lakh 60 hazaar.
Agar return 12% saal ka maan lein, jo guaranteed nahi hai,
Yaani kareeb ₹55 lakh, sirf growth se.
Par twist yeh hai: pehle 5 saal, yeh bahut slow lagega.
5 saal mein, ₹6 lakh daale, aur bane sirf kareeb ₹8.25 lakh.
Par aakhri 3 saal mein hi, kareeb ₹26 lakh judte hain.
Aur agar 5 saal late shuru kiya, yaani sirf 13 saal, toh kareeb ₹37.5 lakh.
5 saal ki deri, aur rakam aadhi se bhi kam.
Toh bacche ke liye sabse bada gift, rakam nahi, time hai.
